svg.title: AI Collaboration Record — All time
svg.desc: 1297 AI-attributed commits, 1343 AI actor presences across 115 active AI days (author dates), 3 AI providers. Daily collaboration pulse 2026-06-06 to 2026-08-28, peak day 33 commits; pulse height encodes total commits, accent fill height encodes the day's AI-attributed share; publishable dates only. Generated 2026-08-28.
